method: Evidence pack from the release file; one Sonnet 5.5 agent established the facts with exact quotes; every quote checked against the release files and README by script; the facts that set the level checked again by hand; level from the fixed rule; label and summary written by Claude Opus 5.5.
label: Runs Claude Code's official installer when you ask it to install Claude Code
summary: When you press its button to install and sign in to Claude Code and confirm, it opens a Terminal or Command Prompt window that runs Claude Code's install script, if Claude Code isn't installed yet; the README shows the same commands. It does nothing on Linux.

facts.what: Anthropic's official Claude Code installer script (claude.ai/install.sh on Mac/Linux, install.ps1 on Windows), piped straight into bash / PowerShell iex inside a visible Terminal or cmd window. It installs the Claude Code program (size not established; script is fetched at run time) and then runs it to sign in.
facts.readmeQuote: Instala o Claude Code: **Windows** (PowerShell) `irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex`, **macOS** `curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash`

sourceQuote.text: // Comandos oficiais de instalação (code.claude.com/docs/en/setup). Fixos: nunca vêm de fora.

facts.notes: Call path: Settings button zia-claude-install (preferences.js:160) -> installClaude() (preferences.js:660) or chat panel button chat.claudeSetup (chatview.js:1863 -> _setupClaude, 2033). Both first show Services.prompt.confirm with prefs.claude.installConfirm: 'A window will open that installs Claude Code from Anthropic's official site, if it is not installed yet, and then opens the sign in...'. Then core.openClaudeSetup() (zoteroia.js:700) first looks for an existing claude executable, writes claude-code-setup.cmd / .command into the plugin work dir via claudeSetupScript (zoteroia.js:646), and opens it in cmd (start) or Terminal (open -a Terminal). Script only runs the installer if the claude binary is missing (Unix: 'if [ ! -x "$CLAUDE_EXE" ]; then ... curl ... | bash'; Windows: 'powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm ... | iex"'). Commands are constants, not from outside. Linux: openClaudeSetup returns opened:false, no download. The same strings are also shown to the user as a manual alternative (claudeInstallCommand, preferences.js:59-60). No hash/signature check by the plugin; the installer itself is Anthropic's. The confirm dialog names Claude Code and 'official site' but not the claude.ai address; I rate asks-first. Not a fork of a reviewed plugin; no existing review compared.
